passes.name: Walking Skeleton
passes.note: Seeded Today snapshot renders from PostgreSQL through Bun API into HTML/CSS/vanilla JS.

passes.name: Safety and Consent Shell
passes.note: User sees app boundaries, crisis guidance, and saves required consent records.

passes.name: Onboarding and Routine Setup
passes.note: User creates profile rhythm and three default daily anchors.

passes.name: Morning Anchor and Quick Check-In
passes.note: User completes first anchor and records a fast DBT check-in.

passes.name: Day Reset and Minimum Viable Day
passes.note: User recovers a disrupted day with one must-do, one regulation action, and deferrals.

passes.name: Evening Diary Card
passes.note: User completes stable DBT diary-card closeout.

passes.name: Skills Library and Guided Exercise
passes.note: User browses DBT skills and completes a guided exercise.

passes.name: Text Coach with Safety Gate
passes.note: User gets structured text coaching with Safety Guardian interruption when needed.

passes.name: Chain Analysis
passes.note: User creates and resumes a structured chain analysis.

passes.name: Live Voice Coach
passes.note: User starts a realtime voice session with captions/transcript preview and safe exit.

passes.name: Insights and Weekly Review
passes.note: User sees patterns, structure score, and weekly recommendations.

passes.name: Session Prep Export
passes.note: User generates a clinician-ready packet from stable fields and selected chain analyses.

passes.name: Privacy, Retention, and Data Controls
passes.note: User manages export, deletion, transcript retention, sharing consent, and app lock settings.

passes.name: Notifications, Offline Capture, and PWA Hardening
passes.note: App installs, captures offline entries, syncs safely, and handles reminders.

tasks.description: Create `public/index.html` with valid HTML5 shell, minimal Anchor branding, `#today-snapshot`, and visible error area.
